1. How do I get Premium membership?

Yalla Premium includes five levels: Patrician, Knight, Baron, Count and Marquis. To get Patrician, Knight or Baron membership, you can subscribe to them. As for Count and Marquis membership, you need to purchase them with golds.
2. How do I get golds for subscribing to Yalla Premium?

Monthly golds are a great benefit for subscribing to Yalla Premium. You will get a monthly allowance of golds worth the subscription fee. Golds will be automatically given to you every day after you log in. Please note that if you don\'t log in, you won\'t receive golds for that day.
3. How do I renew my membership?
Your subscription will renew automatically on the last day of the current billing period unless you turn off auto-renew 24 hours before the end of your billing cycle.
Count or Marquis membership won\'t renew automatically. If you renew before the expiration date or within 10 days of the expiration date, you can get a discount for renewal.
4. How do I cancel my subscription?
Deleting the Yalla app from your phone won’t cancel your subscription — you’ll have to follow the steps below to successfully stop future payments.
Once you do cancel your subscription, you\'ll be able to use Yalla Premium for the remaining days you paid for.
Canceling a subscription doesn\'t retroactively refund subscription payments, and previously paid subscription fees can’t be prorated based on your cancellation date.
Cancellation steps will vary based on the platform you used to subscribe. If you subscribed on your Android device, follow the steps for Android, etc.
If you subscribed using your Google Play Store account:
1. Open the Google Play Store on your Android device
2. Tap the Menu icon and go to Subscriptions
2. Select the subscription you want to cancel
2. Tap your name, then tap Subscriptions
3. Select the subscription you want to cancel
5. How do I change my membership?
You can upgrade from Patrician to Knight or Baron at any time and will be immediately upgraded, but you can\'t upgrade from Patrician to Count or Marquis.
You can downgrade from Baron to Knight or Patrician and the replacement will take effect on the next billing date, but you can\'t upgrade from Baron to Count or Marquis.
You can upgrade from Count to Marquis and will be immediately upgraded, but you can\'t downgrade from Count to Baron, Knight or Patrician.
You can\'t downgrade from Marquis to any lower level of Yalla Premium membership.
If you are not Yalla Premium member yet or your membership has expired, you can purchase any level of Yalla Premium.

The VIP program is different from Yalla Premium. Generally speaking, VIP membership is acquired by earning VIP Points through your in-app purchases, while Yalla Premium membership is acquired through direct purchase.

The period of validity for each VIP level is 90 days. During the 90-day period, if your VIP Points meet the requirement for a higher level, your VIP level will be immediately upgraded and your VIP Points will be reset to 0. Upgrading by skipping a certain level is supported.

If your VIP level is not upgraded during the period, when the period is over, your VIP level will be reset according to the VIP Points you earned within the period, and your VIP Points will be reset to 0. To maintain your current VIP level, you need to accumulate the VIP Points needed from the previous level during the period. Otherwise, your VIP level will be downgraded.

If you are not VIP yet, when your VIP Points meet the requirements of a certain VIP level during a 90-day period, you will reach this VIP level and your VIP Points will be reset to 0. If you fail to reach any VIP level during the 90-day period, your accumulated VIP Points will be reset to 0 when the period ends.

You can earn VIP Points by purchasing golds, Yalla Premium or room lock (1 USD equals to 10 VIP Points). There\'s no upper limit on how many VIP Points you can earn every day.
